profile.name: Ghifari Aulia Azhar Riza
profile.tagline: I build scalable web and mobile apps, microservices, and realtime systems.
bio: I'm a full stack engineer building web and mobile apps with Django, Next.js, Express.js and Flutter, shipped in Docker on AWS and GCP.
Lately I've been splitting monoliths into microservices, building API gateways for third-party integrations, and bringing LLM tools and n8n automation into day-to-day engineering.
Computer Science graduate from Universitas Indonesia (2019 – 2023).

projects.title: Real-time Crowd Detection for Smart-ads Billboards
projects.description: Fog-based IoT system running a YOLO model trained on CrowdHuman to detect crowds in real time, with Apache Kafka streaming to cut latency in ad delivery.

projects.title: Third-party Integration Gateways
projects.description: A set of gateway services, one per provider: payment gateway, digital signature (Privy), insurance platforms and more. Each wraps a third-party API behind a consistent internal interface.

projects.title: EV Charging Platform
projects.description: OCPP WebSocket server for EV charging stations, a Next.js dashboard, and a Flutter app for drivers on iOS and Android.

highlights: Designed and built gateway services for third-party integrations, including payment processing, digital document signing (Privy) and insurance platforms.
Decomposed parts of a monolithic architecture into microservices to improve scalability and maintainability.
Built and optimized internal automation workflows with n8n, reducing manual operational effort.
Used LLM-assisted development tools such as Claude Code to speed up feature work and improve code reliability.
Explored ways to bring LLM capabilities into engineering workflows to raise team productivity.
Maintained and enhanced existing web-based systems to keep daily operations stable.
Developed user interfaces with React.js and Next.js, improving UI performance and responsiveness.
Built server-side applications with Express.js, implementing OCPP for WebSocket management of EV charging stations.
Created cross-platform Flutter apps for iOS and Android that give EV drivers a seamless charging experience.
Containerized every service (API, frontend, WebSocket, database) with Docker for consistent development and production environments.
Helped students understand complex computer network concepts and supported them with assignments.
Ran exercise sessions to deepen engagement and gave feedback on project work.
